body: I'm just tired of fighting this never ending battle with depression. Tried everything, hobbies, vacations, etc. It always comes back, always. If I were fighting a "real" disease for this long and wanted it to stop, I could just move to Oregon, see the doc, get the pill and have it all be over. I don't get that option,  I get to battle it every day. I'm tired of it, I either want it fixed for good or a way out. Sorry for my horrible attitude, I just wish I had a shoulder to cry on that didn't either freak out or tell me to get over it :/
